occurrences.key: No implementation blocker. Complete mode intentionally rejects unsupported/non-finding reports and empty/truncated finding sections even where the legacy compact summary remains permissive. Permission-denied regular-file reads are handled by filesystem exceptions, while the portable deterministic unreadable-input fixture uses a directory; no permission changes were made. The parent owns integration, tracker closure, full sweep and fresh-agent behavior evaluations; these were not run for this deterministic extraction task.
